brand.name: SocialMarket
public_language_rules: start from the pain, never from supplier/network language
never expose portfolio size or internal sourcing quotas
never expose commission, merchant rank or internal scoring
never call the experience an affiliate catalogue
describe external commercial links only through a short transparency disclosure
never fabricate reviews, scarcity, countdowns, shipping speed, warranty or discounts

inspiration_principles: PagePilot: product-page modularity, brand matching, AI-image/creative mindset, sticky conversion controls
Vitals AI Page Builder: editable structured content, theme consistency, product-context generation
PageFly: build-test-optimize CRO mindset and full-funnel composition

visual_language.typography: oversized high-contrast grotesk with compact utility labels
visual_language.imagery: product-first, cinematic crops, clean lifestyle context, no fake product redesign
visual_language.motion: subtle marquee, hover lift, image zoom; respect prefers-reduced-motion

creative_pack.qr_rule: payload must equal the exact validated tracking URL
creative_pack.urgency_rule: use only time-sensitive facts that can be verified; otherwise phrase urgency as a request to check current price/availability

socialscheduler.rule: only creative packs that pass skeptic/evidence checks may be scheduled
